verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows GitLab Duo Chat can search for relevant merge requests and has access to a project's issues, commits, and CI/CD data (gitlab-docs-39, gitlab-docs-48), which touches on finding commits/MRs conversationally but does not document GitLab's broader code/file search or cross-repository search capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-text code search, file search, and search scoped across multiple repositories/projects (e.g., an 'Advanced Search' feature), plus independent corroboration of search quality.
